inputs.text: [excited] Scelidosaurus is one of the very first dinosaurs ever found almost ENTIRELY whole. [amazed] An English worker discovered it [curious] in a cliff, almost a hundred seventy years ago.
[softly] Yep. And its skeleton is still on display today, in London's great museum. [proud] They named it "harrisonii," [warmly] as a gift to the man who found it.
